visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a black tank top and grey sweatpants and a young woman wearing a white short-sleeved top and black skirt stand in a spacious indoor living room. On the dark wooden floor, two white squares are outlined with tape. (2) Both individuals close their eyes and begin to march in place within their respective squares. As they progress, the man begins to drift forward and to the left, while the woman maintains a more central position. (3) They stop marching and open their eyes; the man is surprised to find himself several feet away from his square. They both laugh at the result. (4) They reposition themselves for a second round, which is labeled as an 'advanced version'. (5) They close their eyes again and begin running in place at a much faster pace. The man drifts significantly further this time, moving toward the far side of the room, while the woman remains relatively near her square but drifts slightly backward. (6) They stop running and open their eyes, reacting with intense laughter at the man's final position far from the starting point.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with casual conversational speech between a man and a woman discussing the challenge setup. The tone is excited and playful. A soft background hum of the room is present. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect triggers a transition to upbeat, high-tempo electronic dance music. Clear, rhythmic thudding sounds of feet marching on wood are heard. The speakers talk excitedly over the music. (3) The music pauses briefly as both individuals break into spontaneous laughter and exclamations when they open their eyes. The vocal arousal is high. (4) The electronic music resumes with increased intensity and a faster beat for the 'advanced' round. Loud, rapid footsteps create a percussive texture. (5) Fast-paced verbal commentary continues with frequent high-pitched laughs and breathless speech. (6) A final whoosh-style sound effect leads to a chorus of laughter as the music fades out, concluding the challenge.
